description: Python 3.14 t-strings whose interpolations read `pytest.mark.skip`, `pytest.skip` and `pytest.mark.xfail` (Codex, design review of the Python versions, round 1): an interpolation evaluates the expression and keeps its value in the template. The census of markers reads the two marks as markers it cannot attribute to a test: two WARNs, as for any other read of them, never a FAIL; the reader is not changed to tell a harmless read from a call (`py314-tstring-interpolation-call`). The real runner runs every test.
